name: Adamantine Armor
desc: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide), uncommon
This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
content: Adamantine Armor is a type of Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide) that is categorized as Uncommon in terms of rarity. This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, a highly durable substance, making it one of the hardest armors available. When worn, Adamantine Armor provides protection by reducing any critical hits against the wearer to normal hits. This item does not have any variants and is not considered a variant itself.

name: Ammunition, +1, +2, or +3
desc: Weapon (any ammunition), uncommon (+1), rare (+2), or very rare (+3)

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
content: Ammunition +1, +2, or +3 is a magic item categorized under Ammunition with varying rarity levels. This weapon enhances attack and damage rolls based on its rarity, providing bonuses of uncommon (+1), rare (+2), or very rare (+3). Once the magic ammunition hits a target, it loses its magical properties. This versatile item is essential for enhancing combat abilities and is a valuable asset for any adventurer.

name: Ammunition, +1
desc: Weapon (any ammunition), uncommon
You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
content: Ammunition, +1 is a magical piece of ammunition from the Ammunition equipment category that provides a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This Uncommon rarity item loses its magical properties after hitting a target, making it a valuable asset for enhancing combat effectiveness.

name: Ammunition, +3
desc: Weapon (any ammunition), very rare
You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
content: Ammunition, +3 is a very rare piece of magic ammunition that provides a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls when used with any weapon. Once it hits a target, the ammunition loses its magical properties. This item belongs to the Ammunition equipment category and is considered a variant.

name: Ammunition, +2
desc: Weapon (any ammunition), rare
You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
content: The Ammunition, +2 is a rare piece of magic ammunition that provides a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Once it hits a target, the ammunition loses its magical properties. It belongs to the Ammunition equipment category and has the rarity of Rare. This variant item can be found under the index ammunition-2.

name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)
While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
content: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location is a Wondrous Item (Uncommon) that provides protection from divination magic, making the wearer hidden from such spells and unable to be targeted or perceived through magical scrying sensors. It requires attunement and falls under the equipment category of Wondrous Items.

name: Amulet of the Planes
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)

While wearing this amulet, you can use an action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a successful check, you cast the plane shift spell. On a failure, you and each creature and object within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination. Roll a d100. On a 1-60, you travel to a random location on the plane you named. On a 61-100, you travel to a randomly determined plane of existence.
content: The Amulet of the Planes is a very rare Wondrous Item that requires attunement. When worn, the wearer can use an action to name a familiar location on another plane of existence and make a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a successful check, the wearer casts the plane shift spell, while on a failure, the wearer and nearby creatures and objects travel to a random destination. The destination is determined by rolling a d100, with a result of 1-60 leading to a random location on the named plane and a result of 61-100 leading to a randomly determined plane of existence.

name: Animated Shield
desc: Armor (shield), very rare (requires attunement)

While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate. The shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you use a bonus action to end this effect, or until you are incapacitated or die, at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.
content: The Animated Shield is a very rare magical item belonging to the Armor category. When attuned to it, you can activate its animation by speaking a command word as a bonus action. The shield then hovers in your space to protect you, allowing your hands to remain free. It will stay animated for 1 minute or until you choose to end the effect, becoming incapacitated, or dying. The shield's properties make it a valuable asset in combat situations, enhancing your defense capabilities.

name: Amulet of Health
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)
Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher
content: The Amulet of Health is a rare wondrous item that boosts your Constitution score to 19 while attuned. It has no effect if your Constitution is already 19 or higher, making it a valuable addition for those seeking resilience and endurance. This amulet falls under the Wondrous Items equipment category and is not available in any variants.

name: Armor, +1, +2, or +3
desc: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare (+1), very rare (+2), or legendary (+3)
You have a bonus to AC while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.
content: This magic item is Armor, which comes in variants of +1, +2, or +3. The rarity of this item varies, with options for rare, very rare, or legendary. When worn, the armor provides a bonus to AC based on its rarity level. This versatile equipment falls under the Armor category and is known for enhancing defense capabilities.

name: Armor, +2
desc: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), very rare
You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
content: The Armor, +2 (Very Rare) is a type of armor that provides a +2 bonus to AC when worn. This armor falls under the equipment category of Armor and is classified as very rare in terms of rarity. It can be light, medium, or heavy, making it versatile for different playstyles. This armor is a variant with no additional variants available.

name: Armor, +3
desc: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), legendary
You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
content: Armor, +3 is a legendary piece of equipment that falls under the Armor category with a rarity level of Legendary. This armor provides a +3 bonus to Armor Class (AC) when worn, making it highly valuable for enhancing defense in battle. Additionally, it can be light, medium, or heavy depending on the wearer's preference.

name: Armor of Invulnerability
desc: Armor (plate), legendary (requires attunement)

You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor. Additionally, you can use an action to make yourself immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
content: The Armor of Invulnerability is a legendary plate armor that grants resistance to nonmagical damage while worn. It also allows the wearer to become immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes with a special action that can only be used once per day. This powerful armor falls under the "Armor" equipment category and requires attunement. With its rarity classified as legendary, the Armor of Invulnerability is a valuable asset for those seeking protection against physical harm.

name: Armor of Resistance
desc: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare (requires attunement)
You have resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.
| d10 | Damage Type |
| 1 | Acid |
| 2 | Cold |
| 3 | Fire |
| 4 | Force |
| 5 | Lightning |
| 6 | Necrotic |
| 7 | Poison |
| 8 | Psychic |
| 9 | Radiant |
| 10 | Thunder |
content: The Armor of Resistance is a rare piece of armor that provides resistance to one type of damage while worn, with the damage type chosen by the GM from a list including Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, and Thunder. This armor falls under the equipment category of Armor and requires attunement. It comes in light, medium, or heavy variants, and despite its name, it does not have any actual variants available.

name: Apparatus of the Crab
desc: Wondrous item, legendary

This item first appears to be a Large sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, allowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move either up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus transforms to resemble a giant lobster.
The apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics:
Armor Class: 20
Hit Points: 200
Speed: 30 ft., swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. for both if the legs and tail aren't extended)
Damage Immunities: poison, psychic

To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot. While the apparatus's hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage per minute from pressure.

A creature in the compartment can use an action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.
Apparatus of the Crab Levers
| Lever | Up | Down |
| 1 | Legs and tail extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim. | Legs and tail retract, reducing the apparatus's speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bonuses to speed. |
| 2 | Forward window shutter opens. | Forward window shutter closes. |
| 3 | Side window shutters open (two per side). | Side window shutters close (two per side). |
| 4 | Two claws extend from the front sides of the apparatus. | The claws retract. |

| 5 | Each extended claw makes the following melee weapon attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. | Each extended claw makes the following melee weapon attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). |
| 6 | The apparatus walks or swims forward. | The apparatus walks or swims backward. |
| 7 | The apparatus turns 90 degrees left. | The apparatus turns 90 degrees right. |
| 8 | Eyelike fixtures emit bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. | The light turns off. |
| 9 | The apparatus sinks as much as 20 feet in liquid. | The apparatus rises up to 20 feet in liquid. |
| 10 | The rear hatch unseals and opens. |  The rear hatch closes and seals. |
content: The Apparatus of the Crab is a legendary wondrous item resembling a giant lobster, with an Armor Class of 20, 200 Hit Points, and damage immunities to poison and psychic. This large object can function as a vehicle, requiring a pilot to operate it. The hatch of the apparatus is airtight and watertight, holding enough air for 10 hours of breathing. It can float on water and go underwater up to 900 feet, taking damage from pressure below that depth. The apparatus has levers that can be manipulated to extend legs and tail, open shutters, deploy claws, emit light, and move in different directions. It can also sink or rise in liquid, providing versatility and mobility for its users.

name: Armor of Vulnerability
desc: Armor (plate), rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this armor, you have resistance to  one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly.

***Curse.*** This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when an identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by the remove curse spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have vulnerability to two of the three damage types associated with the armor (not the one to which it grants resistance).
content: Armor of Vulnerability is a rare (Rare) plate armor that grants resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage types, chosen by the GM. However, it is cursed, causing vulnerability to two of the three damage types while attuned to it. Removing the armor does not lift the curse, requiring a remove curse spell to do so. Attunement is necessary to activate the armor's abilities, making it a powerful yet risky choice for protection.

name: Arrow-Catching Shield
desc: Armor (shield), rare (requires attunement)

You gain a +2 bonus to AC against ranged attacks while you wield this shield. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. In addition, whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack against a target within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to become the target of the attack instead.
content: The Arrow-Catching Shield is a rare armor (shield) that provides a +2 bonus to AC against ranged attacks when wielded, in addition to the shield's normal bonus. Attunement is required for its use. While wielding this shield, you can use your reaction to redirect a ranged attack made against a target within 5 feet of you to yourself. This magic item falls under the Armor equipment category and is notable for its defensive capabilities in combat situations.

name: Arrow of Slaying
desc: Weapon (arrow), very rare

An arrow of slaying is a magic weapon meant to slay a particular kind of creature. Some are more focused than others; for example, there are both arrows of dragon slaying and arrows of blue dragon slaying. If a creature belonging to the type, race, or group associated with an arrow of slaying takes damage from the arrow, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.
Once an arrow of slaying deals its extra damage to a creature, it becomes a nonmagical arrow.
Other types of magic ammunition of this kind exist, such as bolts of slaying meant for a crossbow, though arrows are most common.
content: The Arrow of Slaying is a very rare magic weapon belonging to the Ammunition equipment category. It is designed to slay specific creatures, requiring a DC 17 Constitution saving throw for extra piercing damage. Once the arrow deals its extra damage, it loses its magical properties. Variants like bolts of slaying for crossbows exist, but arrows are the most common type of this deadly magic ammunition.

name: Armor, +1
desc: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare
You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
content: The Armor, +1 (Rare) is a piece of armor that provides a +1 bonus to AC when worn. This rare armor falls under the Armor equipment category and is classified as a variant. It can be of light, medium, or heavy armor.

name: Bag of Beans
desc: Wondrous item, rare
Inside this heavy cloth bag are 3d4 dry beans. The bag weighs 1/2 pound plus 1/4 pound for each bean it contains.

If you dump the bag's contents out on the ground,  they explode in a 10-foot radius, extending from the beans. Each creature in the area, including you, must  make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 fire  damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on  a successful one. The fire ignites flammable objects  in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

If you remove a bean from the bag, plant it in dirt  or sand, and then water it, the bean produces an  effect 1 minute later from the ground where it was  planted. The GM can choose an effect from the  following table, determine it randomly, or create an  effect.
| d100 | Effect |

| 01 | 5d4 toadstools sprout. If a creature eats a toadstool, roll any die. On an odd roll, the eater must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 poison damage and become poisoned for 1 hour. On an even roll, the eater gains 5d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour. |
| 02-10 | A geyser erupts and spouts water, beer, berry juice, tea, vinegar, wine, or oil (GM's choice) 30 feet into the air for 1d12 rounds. |
| 11-20 | A treant sprouts. There's a 50 percent chance that the treant is chaotic evil and attacks. |

| 21-30 | An animate, immobile stone statue in your likeness rises. It makes verbal threats against you. If you leave it and others come near, it describes you as the most heinous of villains and directs the newcomers to find and attack you. If you are on the same plane of existence as the statue, it knows where you are. The statue becomes inanimate after 24 hours. |
| 31-40 | A campfire with blue flames springs forth and burns for 24 hours (or until it is extinguished). |
| 41-50 | 1d6 + 6 shriekers sprout |

| 51-60 | 1d4 + 8 bright pink toads crawl forth. Whenever a toad is touched, it transforms into a Large or smaller monster of the GM's choice. The monster remains for 1 minute, then disappears in a puff of bright pink smoke. |
| 61-70 | A hungry bulette burrows up and attacks. |

| 71-80 | A fruit tree grows. It has 1d10 + 20 fruit, 1d8 of which act as randomly determined magic potions, while one acts as an ingested poison of the GM's choice. The tree vanishes after 1 hour. Picked fruit remains, retaining any magic for 30 days. |

| 81-90 | A nest of 1d4 + 3 eggs springs up. Any creature that eats an egg must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature permanently increases its lowest ability score by 1, randomly choosing among equally low scores. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 force damage from an internal magical explosion. |

| 91-99 | A pyramid with a 60-foot-square base bursts upward. Inside is a sarcophagus containing a mummy lord. The pyramid is treated as the mummy lord's lair, and its sarcophagus contains treasure of the GM's choice. |
| 100 | A giant beanstalk sprouts, growing to a height of the GM's choice. The top leads where the GM chooses, such as to a great view, a cloud giant's castle, or a different plane of existence. |
content: Bag of Beans is a Rare Wondrous Item that contains 3d4 dry beans which explode in a 10-foot radius when dumped out, causing 5d4 fire damage. Each bean can be planted to produce a random effect, such as sprouting toadstools, erupting geysers, or summoning treants. These effects range from creating campfires to spawning monsters, with potential benefits or dangers. The item's unique abilities make it a versatile and unpredictable tool for adventurers seeking both aid and chaos in their journeys.

name: Gray Bag of Tricks
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
This ordinary bag, made from gray cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound.

You can use an action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a d8 and consulting the table that corresponds to the bag's color. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on Your Turn. You can use a Bonus Action to Command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to Attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its Nature.
Once three fuzzy Objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.
Gray Bag:
| d8 | Creature |
| 01 | Weasel |
| 02 | Giant Rat |
| 03 | Badger |
| 04 | Boar |
| 05 | Panther |
| 06 | Giant Badger |
| 07 | Dire Wolf |
| 08 | Giant Elk |
content: Gray Bag of Tricks (Uncommon) is a Wondrous Item that allows you to pull fuzzy objects from the bag, which then transform into friendly creatures that act on your behalf. You can command the creature's movements and actions, and it vanishes at dawn or when reduced to 0 Hit Points. The bag can be used three times before needing to recharge at the next dawn. Creatures that can be summoned include Weasel, Giant Rat, Badger, Boar, Panther, Giant Badger, Dire Wolf, and Giant Elk.

Each variant of the bag allows you to pull out a small, fuzzy object that transforms into a friendly creature determined by rolling a d8. The creature acts on your turn and can be commanded with a bonus action. Once three objects have been pulled from the bag, it can't be used again until the next dawn. The Gray Bag summons creatures like Weasels and Dire Wolves, the Rust Bag summons creatures like Lions and Brown Bears, and the Tan Bag summons creatures like Tigers and Giant Hyenas. This magical item adds a unique and unpredictable element to your adventures.

This ordinary bag made from tan cloth allows you to pull out fuzzy objects that transform into creatures when thrown up to 20 feet. The bag can produce friendly creatures such as a Jackal, Ape, Baboon, Axe Beak, Black Bear, Giant Weasel, Giant Hyena, or Tiger. You can command the creature's actions and it vanishes at dawn or when reduced to 0 Hit Points. After three uses, the bag can't be used until the next dawn, making it a versatile and unpredictable tool for adventurers.

name: Bag of Holding
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon

This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires an action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth, unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. Breathing creatures inside the bag can survive up to a number of minutes equal to 10 divided by the number of creatures (minimum 1 minute), after which time they begin to suffocate.

Placing a bag of holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
content: The Bag of Holding is an Uncommon Wondrous Item that defies its outer dimensions by containing a vast interior space capable of holding up to 500 pounds within its 64 cubic feet limit. Weighing 15 pounds regardless of its contents, the bag requires an action to retrieve items stored inside. If overloaded, pierced, or torn, the bag ruptures, scattering its contents in the Astral Plane. Creatures inside can survive for a limited time before suffocating. Placing the bag within an extradimensional space created by another item results in the destruction of both items and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane, sucking nearby creatures through to random locations.

name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
desc: Wondrous Items, rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits:
Your Constitution score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with Dwarves.
In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a 50 percent chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you're capable of growing one, or a visibly thicker beard if you already have one.
If you aren't a dwarf, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:
You have advantage on Saving Throws against poison, and you have Resistance against poison damage.
You can speak, read, and write Dwarvish.
content: The Belt of Dwarvenkind is a Rare wondrous item that grants various benefits when attuned. While wearing this belt, your Constitution score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, and you gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with Dwarves. Additionally, there is a 50 percent chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if capable. If not a dwarf, you also gain advantage on Saving Throws against poison, Resistance against poison damage, and the ability to speak, read, and write Dwarvish.

name: Bead of Force
desc: Wondrous item, rare
This small black Sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, 1d4 + 4 beads of force are found together.

You can use an action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes on impact and is destroyed. Each creature within a 10-foot radius of where the bead landed must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 force damage. A Sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this Sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save, or are partially within the area, are pushed away from the center of the Sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No Attack or other Effect can.

An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the Sphere up to half the creature's walking speed. The Sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.
content: Bead of Force is a Rare Wondrous Item that measures 3/4 inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. When thrown, it explodes on impact within a 10-foot radius, causing 5d4 force damage to creatures needing a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A transparent force sphere then encloses the area for 1 minute, trapping failed saves inside. Enclosed creatures can push against the sphere to move it, with breathable air passing through its walls. The sphere weighs only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.

name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Hill Giant Strength is a rare (Rare) wondrous item that requires attunement. When worn, this belt increases your Strength score to 21. If your Strength is already 21 or higher, the belt has no effect on you. This item falls under the equipment category of Wondrous Items and has a variant form available.

name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Stone Giant Strength is a very rare wondrous item that requires attunement. While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no effect on you. This item falls under the equipment category of Wondrous Items and is considered a variant.

name: Bag of Devouring
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
This bag superficially resembles a bag of holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice.

The extradimensional creature attached to the bag can sense whatever is placed inside the bag. Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly in the bag is devoured and lost forever. When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a 50 percent chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can use its action to try to escape with a successful DC 15 Strength check. Another creature can use its action to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, doing so with a successful DC 20 Strength check (provided it isn't pulled inside the bag first). Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed.

Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The GM determines the time and plane.
If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.
content: The Bag of Devouring is a Very Rare wondrous item that resembles a bag of holding but is actually a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. This creature can sense what is placed inside the bag and devours animal or vegetable matter placed within it, causing it to be lost forever. Living creatures that are partially placed inside the bag have a 50 percent chance of being pulled in, but can attempt to escape with a DC 15 Strength check. Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of material, but once a day the bag spits out its contents into another plane of existence. If the bag is damaged, it is destroyed and its contents are transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.

name: Belt of Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, rarity varies (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a score granted by the belt. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

Six varieties of this belt exist, corresponding with and having rarity according to The Six kinds of true Giants. The belt of Stone Giant Strength and the belt of Frost Giant Strength look different, but they have the same Effect.
| Type | Strength | Rarity |
| Hill Giant | 21 | Rare |
| Stone Giant / Frost Giant | 23 | Very Rare |
| Fire Giant | 25 | Very Rare |
| Cloud Giant | 27 | Legendary |
| Storm Giant | 29 | Legendary |
content: The Belt of Giant Strength is a Wondrous Item (WI) with a varying rarity that requires attunement. When worn, it changes the wearer's Strength score to a specific value based on the type of Giant the belt represents. There are six variants of this belt, each corresponding to a different type of Giant with varying rarities: Hill Giant (21), Stone Giant / Frost Giant (23), Fire Giant (25), Cloud Giant (27), and Storm Giant (29). The effects of the Stone Giant and Frost Giant variants are the same despite their different appearances. This item is ideal for enhancing Strength-related abilities and is a valuable asset for any adventurer in need of a strength boost.

name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Frost Giant Strength is a Very Rare Wondrous Item that requires attunement. While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no effect on you. This item falls under the Wondrous Items equipment category.

name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 29. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Storm Giant Strength is a legendary wondrous item that requires attunement. This belt boosts the wearer's Strength score to an impressive 29, making it ideal for characters who rely on physical prowess in combat. It's important to note that if the wearer's Strength is already 29 or higher, the belt will have no effect. This powerful item can be found in the Wondrous Items category, perfect for adventurers seeking to enhance their combat abilities.

name: Berserker Axe
desc: Weapon (any axe), rare (requires attunement)
You gain a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage Rolls made with this Magic Weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon, your Hit Points maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained.

***Curse.*** This axe is Cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain Cursed, you are unwilling to part with the axe, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have disadvantage on Attack rolls with Weapons other than this one, unless no foe is within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear.

Whenever a Hostile creature damages you while the axe is in your possession, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. While berserk, you must use your action each round to Attack the creature nearest to you with the axe. If you can make extra attacks as part of the Attack action, you use those extra attacks, moving to Attack the next nearest creature after you fell your current target. If you have multiple possible Targets, you Attack one at random. You are berserk until you start Your Turn with no creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear.
content: The Berserker Axe is a rare Weapon that grants a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage Rolls, and increases Hit Points maximum by 1 for each level while attuned. However, it comes with a curse that makes the wielder unwilling to part with it and gives disadvantage on Attack rolls with other Weapons unless no foe is within 60 feet. When damaged by a Hostile creature, a Wisdom saving throw is required to avoid going berserk and attacking the nearest creature with the axe until no foes are within 60 feet. This magic item is powerful but comes with risks, requiring careful management to avoid its curse.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.
content: Boots of Elvenkind is an uncommon wondrous item that grants the wearer the ability to move silently without making any sound. These boots provide advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks related to moving quietly.

name: Belt of Fire Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 25. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Fire Giant Strength is a Very Rare wondrous item that requires attunement, belonging to the Wondrous Items equipment category. When worn, it boosts the wearer's Strength score to 25. If the wearer's Strength is already 25 or higher, the belt has no effect.

name: Boots of Levitation
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)
While you wear these boots, you can use an action to cast the levitate spell on yourself at will.
content: Boots of Levitation is a rare wondrous item that requires attunement, allowing the wearer to cast the levitate spell on themselves at will. These boots belong to the Wondrous Items equipment category and have no variants.

name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
desc: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)
While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 27. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.
content: The Belt of Cloud Giant Strength is a Legendary wondrous item that requires attunement. While wearing this belt, your Strength score is boosted to 27, but only if your current Strength is lower than that. This powerful item is perfect for enhancing physical capabilities in combat or other challenging situations.

name: Boots of Speed
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)

While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your walking speed, and any creature that makes an opportunity attack against you has disadvantage on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.
When the boots' property has been used for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function until you finish a long rest.
content: Boots of Speed is a rare wondrous item that requires attunement, allowing the wearer to double their walking speed and grant disadvantage to any creature making an opportunity attack. By clicking the boots' heels together, this effect can be activated and deactivated, but after 10 minutes of use, the magic stops until a long rest is taken. These boots are categorized under Wondrous Items and are perfect for enhancing mobility and combat prowess.

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)

While you wear these boots, your walking speed becomes 30 feet, unless your walking speed is higher, and your speed isn't reduced if you are encumbered or wearing heavy armor. In addition, you can jump three times the normal distance, though you can't jump farther than your remaining movement would allow.
content: Boots of Striding and Springing is an uncommon wondrous item that requires attunement. When worn, they increase walking speed to 30 feet and allow jumping three times the normal distance, while maintaining speed even when encumbered or wearing heavy armor. These boots are perfect for adventurers looking to enhance their mobility and agility in various situations.

name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
desc: Wondrous item, rare

While this bowl is filled with water, you can use an action to speak the bowl's command word and summon a water elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It weighs 3 pounds and holds about 3 gallons.
content: The Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals is a rare Wondrous Item that allows the user to summon a water elemental by speaking a command word while the bowl is filled with water, similar to casting the conjure elemental spell. The bowl, which weighs 3 pounds and holds about 3 gallons of water, can only be used in this way once per day until the next dawn. This magical item is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep, making it a powerful tool for those seeking control over water-based creatures.

name: Bracers of Archery
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)
While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the longbow and shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such weapons.
content: Bracers of Archery is a Wondrous Item (Uncommon) that grants proficiency with longbows and shortbows, along with a +2 bonus to damage on ranged attacks while attuned.

name: Brooch of Shielding
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)
While wearing this brooch, you have resistance to force damage, and you have immunity to damage from the magic missile spell.
content: Brooch of Shielding is an uncommon Wondrous Item that provides resistance to force damage and immunity to magic missile spell damage when attuned. This magical brooch falls under the equipment category of Wondrous Items and does not have any variants.

name: Boots of the Winterlands
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)
These furred boots are snug and feel quite warm. While you wear them, you gain the following benefits:
* You have resistance to cold damage.
* You ignore difficult terrain created by ice or snow.
* You can tolerate temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit without any additional protection. If you wear heavy clothes, you can tolerate temperatures as low as -100 degrees Fahrenheit.
content: Boots of the Winterlands is an uncommon wondrous item that requires attunement, providing resistance to cold damage, the ability to ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow, and the capability to withstand temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit without additional protection. These furred boots offer warmth and comfort while granting the wearer unparalleled cold weather resilience, making them a valuable asset for adventurers traversing icy landscapes.

name: Candle of Invocation
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)

This slender taper is dedicated to a deity and shares that deity's alignment. The candle's alignment can be detected with the detect evil and good spell. The GM chooses the god and associated alignment or determines the alignment randomly.
| d20 | Alignment |
| 1-2 | Chaotic evil |
| 3-4 | Chaotic neutral |
| 5-7 | Chaotic good |
| 8-9 | Neutral evil |
| 10-11 | Neutral |
| 12-13 | Neutral good |
| 14-15 | Lawful evil |
| 16-17 | Lawful neutral |
| 18-20 | Lawful good |

The candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires an action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from the candle's total burn time.

While lit, the candle sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius. Any creature within that light whose alignment matches that of the candle makes attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks with advantage. In addition, a cleric or druid in the light whose alignment matches the candle's can cast 1stlevel spells he or she has prepared without expending spell slots, though the spell's effect is as if cast with a 1st-level slot.
Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast the gate spell with it. Doing so destroys the candle.
content: The Candle of Invocation, a Very Rare wondrous item that requires attunement, is a slender taper dedicated to a deity with a specific alignment. The candle's alignment, determined by the GM, can be detected using the detect evil and good spell. When lit, the candle emits dim light in a 30-foot radius, granting advantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks to creatures with matching alignments. Clerics or druids with aligned alignments can cast 1st-level spells without expending spell slots while in the light. Additionally, the candle allows for the casting of the gate spell upon its first lighting, at the cost of its destruction after 4 hours of burning.

name: Broom of Flying
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon

This wooden broom, which weighs 3 pounds, functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and speak its command word. It then hovers beneath you and can be ridden in the air. It has a flying speed of 50 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its flying speed becomes 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds. The broom stops hovering when you land.

You can send the broom to travel alone to a destination within 1 mile of you if you speak the command word, name the location, and are familiar with that place. The broom comes back to you when you speak another command word, provided that the broom is still within 1 mile of you.
content: The Broom of Flying is an uncommon Wondrous Item that allows the user to ride it in the air with a flying speed of 50 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, with a reduced speed of 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds. This wooden broom can be sent to a destination within 1 mile if the command word is spoken, and it returns when another command word is spoken. It weighs 3 pounds and stops hovering when landed.

name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
desc: Wondrous item, rare

While a fire burns in this brass brazier, you can use an action to speak the brazier's command word and summon a fire elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The brazier weighs 5 pounds.
content: The Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals is a rare Wondrous Item that allows the user to summon a fire elemental by speaking a command word while a fire burns in the brass brazier, similar to casting the conjure elemental spell. This item weighs 5 pounds and can only be used once per day until the next dawn.

name: Cape of the Mountebank
desc: Wondrous item, rare
This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast the dimension door spell as an action. This property of the cape can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you disappear, you leave behind a cloud of smoke, and you appear in a similar cloud of smoke at your destination. The smoke lightly obscures the space you left and the space you appear in, and it dissipates at the end of your next turn. A light or stronger wind disperses the smoke.
content: The Cape of the Mountebank is a Rare Wondrous Item that allows the wearer to cast the dimension door spell as an action, leaving behind a cloud of smoke when disappearing and reappearing in a similar cloud of smoke at the destination. The smoke lightly obscures the spaces and dissipates after the next turn. This cape, with a faint smell of brimstone, can only be used once per day until dawn.

name: Carpet of Flying (3 ft. × 5 ft.)
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
You can speak the carpet's command word as an  action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.
This carpet is 3 feet by 5 feet and has a flying speed of 80 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its flying speed becomes 40 feet while carrying over 200 pounds.
content: Carpet of Flying (3 ft. × 5 ft.) is a Very Rare wondrous item that allows the user to command it to hover and fly within a 30-foot range. This carpet measures 3 feet by 5 feet and has a flying speed of 80 feet, capable of carrying up to 400 pounds. However, its flying speed decreases to 40 feet when carrying over 200 pounds. The user can speak a command word to control the carpet's movement, making it a versatile and valuable asset for transportation and aerial maneuvers.

name: Carpet of Flying (4 ft. × 6 ft.)
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
You can speak the carpet's command word as an  action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.
This carpet is 4 feet by 6 feet and has a flying speed of 60 feet. It can carry up to 800 pounds, but its flying speed becomes 30 feet while carrying over 400 pounds.
content: Carpet of Flying (4 ft. × 6 ft.) is a Very Rare Wondrous Item that allows you to command it to hover and fly within 30 feet of you. This magical carpet has a flying speed of 60 feet and can carry up to 800 pounds, although its flying speed decreases to 30 feet when carrying over 400 pounds.

name: Bracers of Defense
desc: Wondous item, rare (requires attunement)
While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.
content: The Bracers of Defense are a rare Wondrous Item that grants a +2 bonus to Armor Class when worn without armor or shield. Attunement is required to benefit from this defensive boost. These bracers are unique in their ability to enhance one's protection without the need for traditional armor or shields, making them a valuable asset for those seeking additional defense in combat situations.

name: Carpet of Flying
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
You can speak the carpet's command word as an  action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.
Four sizes of carpet of flying exist. The GM chooses the size of a given carpet or determines it randomly.
| d100 | Size | Capacity | Flying Speed |
A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but it flies at half speed if it carries more than its normal capacity.
content: The Carpet of Flying is a Very Rare Wondrous Item that allows you to make it hover and fly by speaking a command word within 30 feet of it. There are four sizes available - 3 ft. × 5 ft., 4 ft. × 6 ft., 5 ft. × 7 ft., and 6 ft. × 9 ft. Each size has its own capacity and flying speed, with the larger sizes being able to carry more weight but at a reduced speed. The carpet can carry up to twice its normal capacity, but it flies at half speed when overloaded.

name: Carpet of Flying (5 ft. × 7 ft.)
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
You can speak the carpet's command word as an  action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.
This carpet is 5 feet by 7 feet and has a flying speed of 40 feet. It can carry up to 1200 pounds, but its flying speed becomes 20 feet while carrying over 600 pounds.
content: Carpet of Flying (5 ft. × 7 ft.) is a Very Rare Wondrous Item that allows the user to command it to hover and fly within 30 feet. This magical carpet has a flying speed of 40 feet and can carry up to 1200 pounds, though its speed decreases to 20 feet when carrying over 600 pounds. This versatile item is a must-have for adventurers seeking swift and reliable transportation in their journeys.

name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
desc: Wondrous item, rare

While incense is burning in this censer, you can use an action to speak the censer's command word and summon an air elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
This 6-inch-wide, 1-foot-high vessel resembles a chalice with a decorated lid. It weighs 1 pound.
content: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals is a Rare Wondrous Item that allows you to summon an air elemental by burning incense and speaking its command word. This 6-inch-wide vessel resembles a decorated chalice and can only be used once per day until the next dawn, weighing 1 pound.

name: Circlet of Blasting
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon

While wearing this circlet, you can use an action to cast the scorching ray spell with it. When you make the spell's attacks, you do so with an attack bonus of +5. The circlet can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
content: The Circlet of Blasting is an Uncommon Wondrous Item that allows the wearer to cast the scorching ray spell with an attack bonus of +5. This powerful circlet can only be used in this way once per day.

name: Cloak of Displacement
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)

While you wear this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while you are incapacitated, restrained, or otherwise unable to move.
content: The Cloak of Displacement is a Rare (rarity) Wondrous Item (equipment category) that requires attunement. While wearing this cloak, it creates an illusion that causes creatures to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you by making you appear in a different location. However, this effect stops working if you take damage and resumes on your next turn. The illusion is also suppressed if you are unable to move, such as when incapacitated or restrained.

name: Chime of Opening
desc: Wondrous item, rare

This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound. You can strike it as an action, pointing it at an object within 120 feet of you that can be opened, such as a door, lid, or lock. The chime issues a clear tone, and one lock or latch on the object opens unless the sound can't reach the object. If no locks or latches remain, the object itself opens.
The chime can be used ten times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.
content: The Chime of Opening is a Rare Wondrous Item that can be used ten times before becoming useless. This 1-foot long metal tube weighs 1 pound and can open locks, latches, doors, and lids within 120 feet when struck, emitting a clear tone. It is a valuable tool for unlocking objects in a magical or mysterious environment, making it a handy asset for adventurers seeking hidden or guarded treasures.

name: Cloak of Arachnida
desc: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement)
This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits:
* You have resistance to poison damage.
* You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
* You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.
* You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were difficult terrain.
* You can use an action to cast the web spell (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property of the cloak can't be used again until the next dawn.
content: Cloak of Arachnida is a Very Rare Wondrous Item that grants resistance to poison damage, a climbing speed equal to walking speed, the ability to move across vertical surfaces and ceilings, immunity to webs, and the ability to cast an enhanced web spell with a save DC of 13. Attunement is required to benefit from its properties.

name: Carpet of Flying (6 ft. × 9 ft.)
desc: Wondrous item, very rare
You can speak the carpet's command word as an  action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.
This carpet is 6 feet by 9 feet and has a flying speed of 30 feet. It can carry up to 1600 pounds, but its flying speed becomes 15 feet while carrying over 800 pounds.
content: Carpet of Flying (6 ft. × 9 ft.) is a Very Rare wondrous item that allows the user to speak a command word to make it hover and fly within 30 feet. This carpet has a flying speed of 30 feet and can carry up to 1600 pounds, but its flying speed decreases to 15 feet when carrying over 800 pounds.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)

While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, as the cloak's color shifts to camouflage you. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.
content: The Cloak of Elvenkind is a wondrous item (uncommon) that requires attunement. While wearing the cloak with its hood up, it grants disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you, and advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, due to its color-shifting camouflage ability. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action. It belongs to the Wondrous Items equipment category and has no variants.

name: Cloak of the Bat
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)

While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In an area of dim light or darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak with both hands and use it to fly at a speed of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in dim light or darkness, you lose this flying speed.

While wearing the cloak in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to cast polymorph on yourself, transforming into a bat. While you are in the form of the bat, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
content: The Cloak of the Bat is a rare wondrous item that grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and allows the wearer to fly at a speed of 40 feet in dim light or darkness by gripping its edges. Additionally, the wearer can use an action to polymorph into a bat while in dim light or darkness, retaining their mental scores. This cloak requires attunement and can only be used for flying and polymorphing once per day until the next dawn.

name: Cloak of Protection
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)
You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.
content: The Cloak of Protection is an Uncommon wondrous item that grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws when attuned. Belonging to the Wondrous Items equipment category, this magical cloak enhances defense and resilience for the wearer. With its ability to boost protective capabilities, the Cloak of Protection is a valuable asset for adventurers seeking added security in their journeys.

name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater, and you have a swimming speed of 60 feet. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.
content: The Cloak of the Manta Ray is an uncommon Wondrous Item that grants the wearer the ability to breathe underwater and swim at a speed of 60 feet while the hood is up. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action. This magical cloak is part of the Wondrous Items equipment category and does not have any variants. Its unique properties make it a valuable asset for adventurers exploring aquatic environments.

name: Crystal Ball of True Seeing
desc: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)
The crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.
***Crystal Ball of True Seeing.*** While scrying with the crystal ball, you have truesight with a radius of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.
content: The Crystal Ball of True Seeing is a legendary wondrous item that requires attunement. This 6-inch diameter crystal ball allows you to cast the scrying spell with a save DC of 17 while touching it. When scrying with the crystal ball, you gain truesight with a radius of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.

name: Cube of Force
desc: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)
This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it that can be pressed. The cube starts with 36 charges, and it regains 1d20 expended charges daily at dawn.

You can use an action to press one of the cube's faces, expending a number of charges based on the chosen face, as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table. Each face has a different effect. If the cube has insufficient charges remaining, nothing happens. Otherwise, a barrier of invisible force springs into existence, forming a cube 15 feet on a side. The barrier is centered on you, moves with you, and lasts for 1 minute, until you use an action to press the cube's sixth face, or the cube runs out of charges. You can change the barrier's effect by pressing a different face of the cube and expending the requisite number of charges, resetting the duration.
If your movement causes the barrier to come into contact with a solid object that can't pass through the cube, you can't move any closer to that object as long as the barrier remains.
Cube of Force Faces
| Face | Charges | Effect |
| 1 | 1 | Gases, wind, and fog can't pass through the barrier.
| 2 | 2 | Nonliving matter can't pass through the barrier. Walls, floors, and ceilings can pass through at your discretion.
| 3 | 3 | Living matter can't pass through the barrier.
| 4 | 4 | Spell effects can't pass through the barrier.
| 5 | 5 | Nothing can pass through the barrier. Walls, floors, and ceilings can pass through at your discretion.
| 6 | 0 | The barrier deactivates.
The cube loses charges when the barrier is targeted by certain spells or comes into contact with certain spell or magic item effects, as shown in the table below.
| Spell or Item | Charges Lost |
| Disintegrate | 1d12 |
| Horn of blasting | 1d10 |
| Passwall | 1d6 |
| Prismatic spray | 1d20 |
| Wall of fire | 1d4 |
content: The Cube of Force is a Rare wondrous item that requires attunement. It is about an inch across and has 36 charges, regaining 1d20 charges daily at dawn. By pressing different faces, you can create a 15-foot invisible force barrier with various effects, such as blocking gases, nonliving matter, living matter, spell effects, or everything. The barrier moves with you and lasts for 1 minute, or until deactivated. The cube loses charges when targeted by spells like Disintegrate or effects from items like the Horn of Blasting. This versatile item is a valuable asset for defense and strategic positioning in a variety of situations.

name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
desc: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)
The crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

***Crystal Ball of Telepathy.*** While scrying with the crystal ball, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also use an action to cast the suggestion spell (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if scrying ends. Once used, the suggestion power of the crystal ball can't be used again until the next dawn.
content: The Crystal Ball of Telepathy is a legendary wondrous item that requires attunement, allowing you to cast the scrying spell with a save DC of 17. While scrying, you can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of the sensor and cast the suggestion spell with a save DC of 17 on them using an action. The suggestion power can only be used once per day and ends when scrying ends, offering a unique and powerful ability for those skilled in divination and manipulation.

name: Cubic Gate
desc: Wondrous item, legendary

This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the GM.

You can use an action to press one side of the cube to cast the gate spell with it, opening a portal to the plane keyed to that side. Alternatively, if you use an action to press one side twice, you can cast the plane shift spell (save DC 17) with the cube and transport the targets to the plane keyed to that side.
The cube has 3 charges. Each use of the cube expends 1 charge. The cube regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
content: The Cubic Gate is a Legendary Wondrous Item that measures 3 inches across and holds immense magical power. This cube is intricately linked to different planes of existence, allowing the user to cast powerful spells such as gate and plane shift by pressing its sides. With 3 charges that regenerate daily, the Cubic Gate offers unparalleled versatility in transporting beings to various dimensions.

name: Dagger of Venom
desc: Weapon (dagger), rare
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can use an action to cause thick, black poison to coat the blade. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The dagger can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
content: The Dagger of Venom is a rare magic weapon in the Weapon category, providing a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. With a unique ability, the dagger can be coated with poisonous black substance, causing 2d10 poison damage and poisoning the target on a failed DC 15 Constitution saving throw. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until a successful attack. This powerful weapon can only be used in this way once per day until the next dawn, making it a deadly and sought-after tool for skilled fighters.

name: Dancing Sword
desc: Weapon (any sword), very rare (requires attunement)

You can use a bonus action to toss this magic sword into the air and speak the command word. When you do so, the sword begins to hover, flies up to 30 feet, and attacks one creature of your choice within 5 feet of it. The sword uses your attack roll and ability score modifier to damage rolls.

While the sword hovers, you can use a bonus action to cause it to fly up to 30 feet to another spot within 30 feet of you. As part of the same bonus action, you can cause the sword to attack one creature within 5 feet of it.

After the hovering sword attacks for the fourth time, it flies up to 30 feet and tries to return to your hand. If you have no hand free, it falls to the ground at your feet. If the sword has no unobstructed path to you, it moves as close to you as it can and then falls to the ground. It also ceases to hover if you grasp it or move more than 30 feet away from it.
content: The Dancing Sword is a very rare magical weapon that requires attunement. This sword can be tossed into the air with a bonus action and commanded to hover, fly up to 30 feet, and attack a chosen target using the wielder's attack roll and ability score modifier for damage. It can be directed to fly to another spot within 30 feet and attack again with a bonus action. After four attacks, the sword automatically flies back to the wielder's hand if available, or falls to the ground. Maintaining a close proximity to the wielder is crucial for the sword to stay active.

name: Decanter of Endless Water
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

You can use an action to remove the stopper and speak one of three command words, whereupon an amount of fresh water or salt water (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following options:
"Stream" produces 1 gallon of water.
"Fountain" produces 5 gallons of water.

"Geyser" produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a geyser 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. As a bonus action while holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Instead of a creature, you can target an object that isn't being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is either knocked over or pushed up to 15 feet away from you.
content: Decanter of Endless Water is an Uncommon Wondrous Item that allows the user to produce varying amounts of fresh or salt water by speaking one of three command words: "Stream" for 1 gallon, "Fountain" for 5 gallons, and "Geyser" for 30 gallons that can be directed at a target within 30 feet, potentially causing damage or knocking over objects. This 2-pound flask is a versatile tool for creating water-based effects and can be a valuable asset for adventurers needing a portable water source or tactical advantage in combat situations.

name: Crystal Ball
desc: Wondrous item, very rare or legendary (requires attunement)
The typical crystal ball, a very rare item, is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.
The following crystal ball variants are legendary items and have additional properties.

***Crystal Ball of Mind Reading.*** You can use an action to cast the detect thoughts spell (save DC 17) while you are scrying with the crystal ball, targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You don't need to concentrate on this detect thoughts to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if scrying ends.

***Crystal Ball of Telepathy.*** While scrying with the crystal ball, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also use an action to cast the suggestion spell (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if scrying ends. Once used, the suggestion power of the crystal ball can't be used again until the next dawn.
***Crystal Ball of True Seeing.*** While scrying with the crystal ball, you have truesight with a radius of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.
content: Crystal Ball is a very rare Wondrous Item that allows the user to cast the scrying spell with a save DC of 17 while touching it. It comes in multiple variants, including the Crystal Ball of Mind Reading, which enables the user to cast detect thoughts, the Crystal Ball of Telepathy for telepathic communication and casting suggestion spells, and the Crystal Ball of True Seeing, granting truesight within a 120-foot radius.

name: Deck of Illusions
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
This box contains a set of parchment cards. A full deck has 34 cards. A deck found as treasure is usually missing 1d20 - 1 cards.

The magic of the deck functions only if cards are drawn at random (you can use an altered deck of playing cards to simulate the deck). You can use an action to draw a card at random from the deck and throw it to the ground at a point within 30 feet of you.

An illusion of one or more creatures forms over the thrown card and remains until dispelled. An illusory creature appears real, of the appropriate size, and behaves as if it were a real creature except that it can do no harm. While you are within 120 feet of the illusory creature and can see it, you can use an action to move it magically anywhere within 30 feet of its card. Any physical interaction with the illusory creature reveals it to be an illusion, because objects pass through it. Someone who uses an action to visually inspect the creature identifies it as illusory with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. The creature then appears translucent.
The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled. When the illusion ends, the image on its card disappears, and that card can't be used again.

Drawing a card at random creates an illusory creature at a point within 30 feet of you, which can be moved magically within 30 feet of its card. The illusion appears real but can do no harm and is dispelled upon physical interaction or a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. The deck includes cards representing various creatures, such as a Red Dragon, Knight, Succubus, and more. It is a versatile tool for creating temporary illusions for strategic advantage or entertainment purposes.

desc: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement)

content: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading is a legendary wondrous item that requires attunement and belongs to the Wondrous Items equipment category. The detect thoughts spell can target creatures within 30 feet of the spell's sensor without the need for concentration, but ends when scrying ends. This 6-inch diameter crystal ball enhances the user's ability to perceive and understand the thoughts of others, making it a valuable tool for gathering information and insights.

name: Dimensional Shackles
desc: Wondrous item, rare

You can use an action to place these shackles on an incapacitated creature. The shackles adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size. In addition to serving as mundane manacles, the shackles prevent a creature bound by them from using any method of extradimensional movement, including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence. They don't prevent the creature from passing through an interdimensional portal.

You and any creature you designate when you use the shackles can use an action to remove them. Once every 30 days, the bound creature can make a DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature breaks free and destroys the shackles.
content: Dimensional Shackles are a Rare Wondrous Item that can be used to bind incapacitated creatures, preventing them from using extradimensional movement methods such as teleportation. These shackles adjust to fit Small to Large creatures and can only be removed by a designated creature with an action. Once every 30 days, the bound creature can attempt to break free with a DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Dragon Scale Mail
desc: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement)

Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued.

While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to one damage type that is determined by the kind of dragon that provided the scales (see the table).

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest dragon within 30 miles of you that is of the same type as the armor. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.

Additionally, wearers can magically detect the closest dragon of the same type within 30 miles once per day. This highly valued armor is crafted from dragon scales and offers unique protective abilities tailored to different dragon types, making it a coveted asset for adventurers facing draconic foes.

desc: Weapon (any sword), rare
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

content: Dragon Slayer is a rare Weapon that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. name: Dust of Disappearance
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon

Found in a small packet, this powder resembles very fine sand. There is enough of it for one use. When you use an action to throw the dust into the air, you and each creature and object within 10 feet of you become invisible for 2d4 minutes. The duration is the same for all subjects, and the dust is consumed when its magic takes effect. If a creature affected by the dust attacks or casts a spell, the invisibility ends for that creature.
content: Dust of Disappearance is an Uncommon Wondrous Item that, when thrown into the air, makes you and everything within 10 feet invisible for 2d4 minutes. This fine sand-like powder is found in a small packet and is consumed upon use. If an invisible creature attacks or casts a spell, the invisibility ends for that creature.

name: Dust of Dryness
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon

This small packet contains 1d6 + 4 pinches of dust. You can use an action to sprinkle a pinch of it over water. The dust turns a cube of water 15 feet on a side into one marble-sized pellet, which floats or rests near where the dust was sprinkled. The pellet's weight is negligible.
Someone can use an action to smash the pellet against a hard surface, causing the pellet to shatter and release the water the dust absorbed. Doing so ends that pellet's magic.

An elemental composed mostly of water that is exposed to a pinch of the dust must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
content: The Dust of Dryness is an Uncommon Wondrous Item that can transform water into a marble-sized pellet when sprinkled over it. This pellet can release the absorbed water when smashed against a hard surface, ending its magic. Additionally, the dust can inflict necrotic damage on water-based elementals upon contact, requiring a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
desc: Wondrous item, uncommon
Found in a small container, this powder resembles very fine sand. It appears to be dust of disappearance, and an identify spell reveals it to be such. There is enough of it for one use.

When you use an action to throw a handful of the dust into the air, you and each creature that needs to breathe within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become unable to breathe, while sneezing uncontrollably. A creature affected in this way is incapacitated and suffocating. As long as it is conscious, a creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on it on a success. The lesser restoration spell can also end the effect on a creature.
content: Dust of Sneezing and Choking is an uncommon wondrous item found in a small container, resembling fine sand. It can incapacitate creatures within 30 feet by causing uncontrollable sneezing and suffocation with a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. The effect can be ended with a successful saving throw or the lesser restoration spell.

desc: Armor (plate), very rare

While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can use your reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.
content: Dwarven Plate (DP) is a very rare armor with a +2 bonus to AC. While wearing DP, you can use your reaction to reduce involuntary movement by up to 10 feet. DP belongs to the Armor equipment category and has no variants.

name: Dwarven Thrower
desc: Weapon (warhammer), very rare (requires attunement by a dwarf)

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 damage or, if the target is a giant, 2d8 damage. Immediately after the attack, the weapon flies back to your hand.
content: The Dwarven Thrower is a very rare (Very Rare) magic weapon categorized under Weapon (weapon). This warhammer requires attunement by a dwarf and grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It possesses the thrown property with a range of 20 feet (normal) and 60 feet (long). Upon hitting a target, it deals an additional 1d8 damage or 2d8 damage against giants. Notably, the weapon magically returns to the wielder's hand after each ranged attack.

name: Deck of Many Things
desc: Wondrous item, legendary
Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have only thirteen cards, but the rest have twenty-two.

Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly (you can use an altered deck of playing cards to simulate the deck). Any cards drawn in excess of this number have no effect. Otherwise, as soon as you draw a card from the deck, its magic takes effect. You must draw each card no more than 1 hour after the previous draw. If you fail to draw the chosen number, the remaining number of cards fly from the deck on their own and take effect all at once.
Once a card is drawn, it fades from existence. Unless the card is the Fool or the Jester, the card reappears in the deck, making it possible to draw the same card twice.
